title: TE Display Sequencing Protocol (TED-Seq)
author: Pol Vendrell Mir
materials: NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit

Annealing adapters (final concentration 30uM): In a 0.2ml tube, mix: 90µl of 100µM P7_adapter_up (in 10mM Tris-HCl pH8) 90µl of 100µM P7_adapter_bottom (in 10 mM Tris-HCl pH8) 30µl T4 DNA Ligase Reaction Buffer (NEB) 90µl H 2 O In a thermocycle,heat to 95 °C and maintain the temperature for 2 min. Cool to 25 °C over 45 min. (0.026C per seg) Cool to 4 °C for temporary storage. Centrifuge the PCR tube briefly to draw all moisture away from the lid. Note: We recommend preparing aliquots of 50ul (40 reactions) of the custom adapter to avoid repeated freeze–thawing Long term storage at -20°C [C] P7_Primer_index = 10µM in 10 mM Tris-HCl pH8 (stock in 100uM) [C] P5_TE_primer = 10µM in 10mM Tris-HCl pH8 (stock in 100uM)

steps.title: Fragment DNA
steps.instruction: Sonicate 50µl of 20ng/µl DNA (1µg) using a Covaris program. For short-reads (400-700bp), use Peak incident power 75W, Duty factor 18.6%, 200 Cycles per burst for 175 seconds. For large fragments (750-1500bp), use 50W, 2% duty factor, 200 cycles per burst for 3 minutes. Load 100ng on a 1% agarose gel to control size. Use 500ng for subsequent steps.

steps.title: End Repair and A-tailing
steps.instruction: Prepare the End Prep reaction in a sterile nuclease-free tube and thermocycle.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 μl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix, 3.5 μl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer, and 25 μl Fragmented DNA (500ng) for a total volume of 30 μl.
Mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times with a 100 μl or 200 μl pipette set to 25 μl, then quick spin.
Thermocycle with heated lid ≥ 75°C: 30 mins @ 20°C, 30 mins @ 65°C, then hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate custom adapters to the end-prepped DNA.

substeps.instruction: To the 30 μl End Prep mixture, add 15 μl NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix (mix by pipetting first), 0.5 μl NEBNext Ligation Enhancer, and 1.25 μl Custom Adapter (30µM) for a total volume of 46.75 μl.
Mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times with a pipette set to 40 μl, then quick spin.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes in a thermocycler with the heated lid off.

steps.title: Double-Sided Bead Cleanup (Ligation)
steps.instruction: Perform a two-step AMPure XP bead cleanup to remove unwanted fragments.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend. Add 7.5 μl (~0.16X) beads to the 46.75 μl ligation reaction. Mix by pipetting 10 times or vortex 3-5s on high. Incubate on bench for at least 5 mins.
Place on magnetic stand. After 5 mins (solution clear), transfer the supernatant (containing DNA) to a new tube; discard beads.
Add 7.5 μl (~0.16X) resuspended beads to the supernatant. Mix 10 times and incubate on bench for at least 5 mins.
Place on magnetic stand. After 5 mins, discard the supernatant; keep the beads.
Wash beads twice: Add 200 μl 80% freshly prepared ethanol, incubate 30s, and discard supernatant. Repeat once more, removing all visible liquid.
Air dry beads on the stand for up to 5 mins (do not overdry).
Elute DNA by adding 80μl (or 8μl depending on version) of 10 mM Tris-HCl. Mix 10 times or vortex, and incubate for at least 2 mins.
Place on magnetic stand. After 5 mins, transfer 75 μl (or 7.5 μl) to a new PCR tube. Store at -20°C if needed.

steps.title: First PCR Amplification (Outer Primers)
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of PCR using outer primers.

substeps.instruction: In a sterile strip tube, combine 7.5 μl Adapter Ligated DNA, 12.5 μl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 2.5 μl TEDseq_outer_for (10µM), and 2.5 μl TE_outer_rev (10µM) for a total volume of 25 μl.
Mix by pipetting 10 times with a pipette set to 20 μl, then quick spin.
Run thermocycler: 98°C 30", then 20 cycles of (98°C 10", 61°C 75"), then 61°C 5', hold at 4°C.

steps.title: First PCR Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the first PCR product using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads. Add 22.5 μl (0.9X) or 17.5 μl (0.7X) resuspended beads to the PCR reaction. Mix 10 times or vortex 3-5s. Incubate on bench for at least 5 mins.
Place on magnetic stand. After 5 mins, discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice: Add 100 μl 80% ethanol, incubate 30s, and discard supernatant. Repeat once.
Air dry beads for up to 5 mins (keep dark brown and glossy).
Elute DNA with 17µl of 10 mM Tris-HCl. Mix 10 times or vortex, and incubate for at least 2 mins.
Place on magnetic stand. After 5 mins, transfer 17 μl to a new PCR tube. Store at -20°C.

steps.title: Second PCR Amplification (Nested PCR)
steps.instruction: Perform nested PCR using indexed primers.

substeps.instruction: In a sterile strip tube, combine 7.5 μl DNA from previous step, 12.5 μl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 2.5 μl P7_Primer_index# (10µM), and 2.5 μl P5_linker_TE_primer (10µM) for a total volume of 25 μl.
Mix by pipetting 10 times with a pipette set to 20 μl, then quick spin.
Run thermocycler: 98°C 30", then 6 cycles of (98°C 10", 61°C 75"), then 10 cycles of (98°C 10", 72°C 75"), then 72°C 5', hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform final purification of the nested PCR product.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads. Add 22.5 μl (0.9X) or 17.5 μl (0.7X) resuspended beads to the PCR reaction. Mix 10 times or vortex 3-5s. Incubate on bench for at least 5 mins.
Place on magnetic stand. After 5 mins, discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice: Add 100 μl 80% ethanol, incubate 30s, and discard supernatant. Repeat once.
Air dry beads for up to 5 mins (keep dark brown and glossy).
Elute DNA with 33 μl of 10 mM Tris-HCl. Mix 10 times or vortex, and incubate for at least 2 mins.
Place on magnetic stand. After 5 mins, transfer 30 μl to a new PCR tube. Store at -20°C.

steps.title: Nanopore Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the final library for Oxford Nanopore sequencing using Kit 14 (SQK-LSK114).

substeps.instruction: Follow the Genomic_DNA_by_Ligation_SQK-LSK114 protocol with these modifications: Pool all indexed samples for a final amount of 1 µg DNA.
Increase End-Prep incubation to 20 minutes at 20°C and Ligation incubation to at least 1 hour.
Elute in 10 mM Tris-HCl.
Use LFB for the final size selection step.
Quantify DNA using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Q33230).
